metadata.notes: Webhook payload shape: { event, source, version, timestamp, userId, data: { language, promptLength, userEmail, userName, userPhone } }

mapper.subject: Your AI Action Plan is ready — I Supply Chain
mapper.body:
✅ Your AI Action Plan is ready

Hi {{1.body.data.userName}},

Your AI-generated action plan has been created and is waiting for you in the platform.

→ View My AI Plan

The plan includes prioritised actions, timelines, and resource guidance tailored to your supply-chain data.


Best regards,
The I Supply Chain Team

metadata.notes: 1.body.data.userEmail and 1.body.data.userName come from the nested data envelope in the webhook payload. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN.

mapper.data: {"messaging_product":"whatsapp","to":"{{1.body.data.userPhone}}","type":"text","text":{"body":"✅ Your AI action plan is ready! Log in to view it: https://YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN/"}}

metadata.notes: Optional — disable or delete this module if you do not use WhatsApp Business API. 1.body.data.userPhone comes from the nested data envelope.

setupSteps: 1. In Make.com, create a new scenario and import this JSON (three dots → Import Blueprint).
2. Click the Webhook module and copy the generated webhook URL.
3. In ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks, create a webhook with event 'ai_plan.generated' and paste that URL.
4. Add your Gmail connection to the Gmail module.
5. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in the Gmail body.
6. For WhatsApp: replace REPLACE_WITH_PHONE_NUMBER_ID and REPLACE_WITH_WHATSAPP_TOKEN with your Meta Business API credentials. If not using WhatsApp, disable or delete that module.
7. Note: all user fields (userEmail, userName, userPhone) are nested under 1.body.data — the template already uses the correct paths.
